“Why is the land titles record the authority on a boundary?”
Because the registered survey attached to the title is what defines the parcel.
A listing sheet or a municipal tax notice describes the property for other
purposes; neither is authoritative on where the boundary runs.

Know where your learners stand before exam day.

ReadyEngine is an online platform that personalizes exam preparation
and makes each learner’s readiness visible.

ReadyRating shows readiness on a scale of one to five, based on each learner’s
demonstrated understanding of the concepts their exam requires.

The breakdown shows which concepts need more practice.

Here’s how it works.

As learners answer practice questions,
ReadyEngine identifies where they need more support.

That shapes a study plan around their needs and exam date,
with lessons and practice focused on what to work on next.

Practice exams are aligned to the concepts covered on the exam.

Learners can ask questions and get explanations
through Riley, their 24/7 study assistant.

ReadyEngine keeps checking. It looks for understanding
demonstrated more than once, without help.

As learners practise, their study plan and ReadyRating update.

Concepts that need more attention return to the plan.

Help learners focus their preparation, and give your team a clearer view
of where support is needed before exam day.
